recipe.inventory: all original CAL46; fixed-native compatible44 only
recipe.reference_phase: fixed geometry-only ALIGN._reference_alignment; no pose-error choice
recipe.applicability: ONLY v26 restored-prepartial source-policy runtime active groups; all CAL46 inventory retained
recipe.group: one physical native edge; distinct inlier support sets; exact TLS fit variants within each support
recipe.component_prior: equal total mass per distinct support; equal split among its distinct exact fitted variants
recipe.support_anchor: actual unweighted inlier centroid projected onto saved weighted-TLS line; same runtime gauge
recipe.residual: normal offset at support anchor and unoriented angular sine
recipe.normal_floor: fn=max(1 pixel, actual inlier RMS); variance=fn^2
recipe.weighting: equal supported sessions, equal supported frames within session, equal physical edges within frame
recipe.estimator: uncentered radial-pseudo-Huber mixture NLL with covariance log volume
recipe.optimizer: L-BFGS-B on nonnegative scaled variance components
recipe.prior_used_in: uncentered NLL, variance gradient, optimizer conditioning weightedmedians, LOGO heldout NLL, runtime mixture
recipe.replacement: restore nonfallback prepartial 2D; remove own old-normal/tangent/oldpartial owner costs only; shared surviving owners remain once
recipe.one_direction_complete_tangent: exact archived complete measurement and original observer guide; variance x4 engineering
recipe.unknown_complete_source: preserve exact original complete q/covariance/reliability, including prepartial
recipe.tangent_gamma_model: reuse frozen v24 global model; not fitted here; no O/S/pose-prior calibration changes
recipe.original_partial_hard_guards: unchanged measurements, full boundary intervals, OT/U/depth/geometry/canvas
recipe.same_support_claim: cost ownership suppression, not a new proof of identical historical pixel supports
